title: Tower of Hanoi moves
prompt: Solve the Tower of Hanoi puzzle with 4 disks using the minimum number of moves, moving all disks from peg A to peg C and using peg B as the spare peg. Print one line per move in the form `A -> C` (the peg the disk is taken from, then ` -> `, then the peg it is put on). The first move is `A -> B`.
expected_output:
A -> B
A -> C
B -> C
A -> B
C -> A
C -> B
A -> B
A -> C
B -> C
B -> A
C -> A
B -> C
A -> B
A -> C
B -> C
